headline: Public hearing on variance petitions for signs at 616 Broadway and 290 Ferry Street, and for a two-family dwelling at 58-60 Bainbridge Street.
summary: The meeting will hear three variance petitions. Two concern signs, and one concerns a two-family dwelling that would exceed 2½ stories.
items: Petition 26-008, 616 Broadway Holding LLC on behalf of Delight Medicals Inc.: sign variance under Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (C) for 616 Broadway, Parcel ID 160-625-501, plans SGER-078291-2026
Petition 26-009, Malden Cosmetic Dentistry and Implant: sign variance under Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (A) for 290 Ferry Street, Parcel ID 085-407-701, plans SGER-072956-2025
Petition 26-010, Fesehaye Zewdie: variance under Title 12 Section 12.16.010 for a two-family dwelling at 58-60 Bainbridge Street to exceed 2½ stories, Parcel ID 114-711-169, plans Res-078374-2026
location: Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St., Room #106 Herbert L Jackson Council Chambers, Malden, MA

Board of Appeal - Public Meeting
November 18, 2026
 Agenda
The Malden Board of Appeal will hold a Public Hearing Wednesday, November 18, 2026,  at 6:30 pm 
at Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St., Room #106 Herbert L Jackson Council Chambers, Malden, MA 
on the following named petitions:
This meeting may be recorded by Urban Media Arts, formerly known as Malden Access Television.
Order of Petitions to be determined by Chairperson
Old and New Business:
Approval of Minutes of the September 16, 2026 meeting
PUBLIC HEARING:
Petition 26-008 by 616 Broadway Holding LLC on behalf of Delight Medicals Inc. ,  seeking a 
variance under Code of the City of Malden as amended – Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (C) Table of 
Intensity Regulations: Specifically: Regulation of Signs; By District as per plans  SGER-
078291-2026  at the property known as and numbered 616 Broadway. , Malden,  MA and also 
known by City Assessor ’s Parcel ID # 160-625-501
Petition 26-009 by Malden Cosmetic Dentistry and Implant  seeking a variance under Code of 
the City of Malden as amended – Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (A) Table of Intensity Regulations: 
Specifically: Regulation of Signs; By District as per plans SGER-072956-2025  at the 
property known as and numbered 290 Ferry Street. , Malden,  MA and also known by City 
Assessor ’s Parcel ID # 085-407-701
Petition 26-010 by Fesehaye Zewdie seeking a variance under Code of the City of Malden as 
amended – Title 12 Section 12.16.010  Table of Intensity Regulations: Specifically: 
Dimensional Controls for a Dwelling, Two Family Detached. Building to Exceed 2 ½ Stories 
as per plans Res-078374-2026  at the property known as and numbered 58-60 Bainbridge 
Street, Malden,  MA and also known by City Assessor ’s Parcel ID # 114-711-169
Petitions and plans are available for public review on the City website at
https://maldenma-energovweb.tylerhost.net/apps/SelfService#/home. Search Records by Permit Application #
